read.thesis: Q2 adjusted EBITDA rose 5.4% to $677.9M on a $100M one-off Florida Medicaid catch-up, while the full-year Adjusted EBITDA midpoint was trimmed 1.9% and Adjusted EPS midpoint 2.6%; underlying acute same-facility margin was flat-to-down.

capex.quote: during the full year of 2026, we expect to spend approximately $950 million to $1.1 billion on capital expenditures

triggers.label: Adj EBITDA midpoint down 1.9%
triggers.quote: The midpoint of our revised 2026 forecasted Adjusted EBITDA net of NCI, represents a decrease of 1.9%

triggers.label: Behavioral rev/adj admission +7.1%
triggers.quote: net revenue per adjusted admission increased by 7.1%

guidance.metric: Adjusted EBITDA net of NCI FY26

guidance.quote: we expect to spend approximately $950 million to $1.1 billion on capital expenditures

red_flags.label: Q2 EBITDA lifted by $100M prior-period Medicaid catch-up
red_flags.quote: a favorable net pre-tax impact of $100 million (net of related provider taxes) recorded in connection with the Florida Medicaid managed care directed payment program

red_flags.label: Working capital drag: CFO down $64M; DSO 50→56
red_flags.quote: an unfavorable change of $207 million in other working capital accounts due primarily to the timing of accounts payable disbursements

red_flags.label: Cumberland Hospital litigation
red_flags.quote: the final resolution of these matters could have a material adverse effect on the Company
